question: how many candidates took part in the 2021 aims ttp regional olympiads
answer: 478 out of 534 registered candidates participated, across centres in seven regional headquarters.
evidence: Out of the 534 candidates initially registered for the AIMS TTP Regional Olympiads, 478 candidates participated in centres across the headquarters of the seven regions.

question: when were the 2021 regional olympiad results published
answer: Results were published by Friday 23 April 2021.
evidence: results of this first challenge will be published by Friday 23rd April 2021.
